reading.title: Gardening and Socializing
reading.text:
Nadia usually wakes up early to tend to her garden. She waters the plants and pulls out any weeds. On weekends, she often invites friends over for a barbecue. During the week, she prefers to stay in, reading or watching TV. In contrast, Ella sleeps in late on Saturdays, spending the morning browsing online stores. On Sunday afternoons, she goes to the gym and then meets up with her book club. At work, Ella usually has a packed schedule, attending meetings all day.

Nadia's weekends are filled with gardening activities and hosting friends for meals. She loves preparing homemade dishes and enjoying company outside. Every Saturday, Nadia spends hours in her garden, planting new flowers and trimming shrubs. Her friends appreciate the relaxed atmosphere and delicious food she serves. Ella, on the other hand, finds her weekdays more hectic. She runs from one meeting to another, rarely having time for socializing. During lunch breaks, she grabs quick meals at work or orders takeout.

On Fridays, Nadia starts early to prepare a special meal for her guests, while Ella finishes her meetings and rushes home to change before her book club meeting.

reading.summaryTask: Retell the text aloud in 60 seconds using three key words.

writing.task: Write an email to your friend about your weekend plans. Compare what you usually do on the weekends with what you will be doing this weekend.
checklist: Use present simple for usual activities.
Use present continuous for this weekend’s plans.
writing.model: Hi Sarah! This weekend is going to be different. Usually, I read books and watch TV at home on Saturdays. But now, I'm meeting my friends for a picnic in the park. On Sundays, I normally go hiking with my family. This time, we're planning to visit your uncle in town. See you next week! Best, Alex
